rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 3.2 and 4 (Figures 8-14) report the author's own fuzzy controller design and LabView simulation runs for greenhouse temperature/air speed and humidity/irrigation time for tulip production in Ilo, Peru.
rows.notes: The study is a pure software simulation (LabView Fuzzy System Designer) of an on-off fuzzy controller; no greenhouse measurements, no sensor data, no comparison of model output with observations are reported (a vague mention of verification 'during the real-time implementation' is unsupported by any data). It does not quantify energy or water use, savings, or any irrigation outcome; it only shows that the controller switches outputs when inputs deviate from the 15<U+00B0>C setpoint or humidity classes. Claims of reduced crop damage and energy/water saving are asserted, not measured. Hence no own evidence on water conservation; the study at most demonstrates a controller design that is a precondition for the claimed effect.

notes: Conference paper (Procedia Computer Science) presenting a LabView fuzzy-logic simulation; results section consists of screenshots of the controller interface with no numerical performance, validation, or uncertainty data. Figures are not reproduced in the text supplied.
